meta.title: Campaign cockpit competitor evidence base
meta.prepared_for: nad-lan.co.il developer campaign cockpit (pick countries, languages, communities, budget; annual subscription; leads land in the live 3D project page)
meta.method: Read-only desk research with web search and page fetches on 2026-11-07. No accounts, no forms, no contact with any company. Every field carries the URLs actually read and the retrieval date.
meta.field_format: Each service field is {value, sources, retrieved}. 'not published' means the checked public pages do not state it. Values read through a search-engine copy of a blocked page say so ('per search index' or 'as indexed by search'). Third-party figures name the publication and date.
caveats: Several official sites blocked direct reading (Yad2, Madlan, Homeless, Bayut and Property Finder help centres, Properstar dashboard, list.juwai.com, Zillow, Domain, Kyero, idealista). Their values come from the search-engine copy of the same page and are labelled.

Self-reported audience numbers often disagree on the same site (for example immobilier.co.il 113 vs 67 portals, Properstar 45 to 120 portals, Icube 95 vs 200 salons, Kyero 3 million vs 1.2 million visits). Both figures are kept.
Merged objects: immobilier.co.il (lead campaigns plus listing plans, values separated by ' | '), Rightmove (New Homes plus Overseas). Buy It In Israel merges two cross-checked reads.

No named, dated Israel-specific benchmark for real-estate CPM, CPC or cost per lead was found. The web search budget for this run was used up before a deeper Hebrew search; a follow-up run can extend it.
Names of some exhibitors and developer logos were read from image file names only and are marked unconfirmed in the values.

services.name: Yad2 new projects (Yad2 Nadlan Hadash, the Yad1 section)
services.market: Israel. Reaches Hebrew-speaking buyers living in Israel. Since 29.9.2026 also runs a Hebrew arena that shows Cyprus projects to Israeli buyers (pilot, Greece and Portugal planned), which is the reverse direction of selling Israeli projects abroad.

sells_to_developers.value: 1) New-projects section (Yad1) with one page per project, branded with the developer name, unit types, price-from and promotions; site menu has a 'פרסום פרויקט' (advertise a project) entry and a developer sales page promising exposure to buyers with high purchase intent, an experienced team and flexible ad packages (sales page as indexed by search; direct fetch blocked by a bot check). 2) Per Calcalist, 17.1.2024: solutions for developers and contractors to get quality leads through campaigns and large-scale performance activity, management of the client's digital activity based on Yad2's data, and a dedicated client system called 'yad2+'. 3) Physical new-homes fair 'Nadlanation' at Expo Tel Aviv (5-6 April 2024, 20-21 September 2024, 24-25 July 2025) where developers exhibit and sell on special terms; title sponsor Bank Leumi in 2024. 4) Since 29.9.2026 an overseas-projects arena that gives foreign-project developers (named: the Israeli firm 'שבירו' and the Cyprus firm Zavos Group) exposure to the Israeli audience; payment model not published. 5) Recruiting texts (October 2026) describe an 'end-to-end' offering for new residential projects with a B2B go-to-market to developers and B2C campaigns to buyers (job listing as indexed by search).

prices_and_terms.value: Developer package prices: not published. Fair exhibitor cost: not published. Terms of use (Korel-Tel Ltd): ads by business customers are paid-only; buying a package jointly with another customer is forbidden and can be fined 5,000 NIS; paid ads cancelled before the end of the period are not refunded; a full refund applies only if cancelled before the ad is actually published. Per TheMarker, 8.11.2024: Yad2 raised advertising prices for real estate brokers by 'tens of percent' during the war (no amounts in the visible text). Per Calcalist Tech, 29.10.2025: developers bring 36% of Yad2 real estate revenue, real estate is 56% of total revenue, 2025 revenue expected EUR 73.1 million (later updated to EUR 83 million).

channels.value: Own portal and app (largest Israeli classifieds site); Yad2 magazine and blog posts about new projects; TV campaign for the fair with presenter Maya Wertheimer and free buyer pre-registration via landing page or phone *3332 (shivuk.me, 29.3.2024); physical fair at Expo Tel Aviv; performance campaigns run on Yad2 data (Calcalist 2024). Per Calcalist, 2.2.2025: fair exhibitors 'collected thousands of leads and hundreds of registrations', exhibitors were developers 'from Israel and abroad'. Newsletter size, partner portals, WhatsApp marketing: not published. No foreign-language or overseas buyer channel found.

targeting_options.value: Per Calcalist, 17.1.2024: campaigns and digital activity are managed based on Yad2's own data repository. Published targeting menu (country, language, diaspora community, budget, buyer profile, retargeting): not published. All observed targeting is the Israeli, Hebrew-reading audience.

lead_handling.value: Project pages ask buyers to 'leave details' for more information or to arrange a tour (project pages as indexed by search). Terms of use, section 17.2: buyers can leave their details and 'the various developers will be able to contact you'. Terms section 16.4 describes virtual phone numbers that hide the advertiser's real number (a call-tracking style mechanism). Per a third-party broker FAQ (undated), each Yad1 project page has a contact form that goes to the developer or the project sales rep. Lead verification, replacement or refund guarantee, CRM integration, delivery speed, WhatsApp delivery: not published.

reporting_dashboard.value: Per Calcalist, 17.1.2024: a dedicated system 'yad2+' lets clients manage their activity in one place, and Yad2 gives tools to measure advertising results on the site; per Calcalist, 2.2.2025: tools to measure results and understand the market. Screens, metrics, live vs monthly: not published.

self_serve_builder.value: No self-serve campaign builder for developers found. Developers go through a sales contact page and a sales team ('experienced team', 'flexible packages'). Private ads are self-serve, but new-project packages are sold by reps.

tour_3d_project_page.value: Project page lives on Yad2 (not on the developer's site): developer name, unit count, rooms, floors, price-from, promotions, contact form. Per a third-party broker FAQ (undated): floor plans and 'advanced virtual tours'. A native 3D model of the building, map-based 3D, or embedding a developer's own 3D page: not found.

languages.value: Hebrew only observed. The overseas arena explicitly presents project information in Hebrew (ynet, 29.9.2026). No English, French, Russian or Arabic interface found on the pages checked.

audience_size_claims.value: Yad2 developer sales page (as indexed by search, period not stated): 4,000,000 entries, 1,600,000 visitors and 650,000 views of new projects. Per Calcalist Tech, 29.10.2025: 4 million unique visitors per month and about 230 million visits a year; about 90% of users do not pay. Per Calcalist, 2.2.2025: more than 18 million visits per month. Per Calcalist, 17.1.2024: more than 15 million visits per month and 99% aided awareness. Fair: close to 18,000 visitors and about 40 developers at the earlier fair (nadlancenter, 9.9.2024).

clever_features.value: 1) Offline fair plus TV campaign, free buyer pre-registration, a 250,000 NIS raffle toward an apartment, developers collect leads face to face. 2) Data-driven performance campaigns plus the 'yad2+' client system. 3) Virtual phone numbers that hide the developer number (call tracking). 4) Separate published audience number for new projects (650,000 views). 5) Overseas arena with search, filter and compare, and planned financing, tax and purchase-process content. 6) Mortgage partner on site (Bank Leumi). 7) Developers are a large paying segment: 36% of Yad2 real estate revenue (Calcalist Tech 2025).

weaknesses_observed.value: No published developer price list or media kit; sales-rep model only, no self-serve; Hebrew only; reach is Israeli residents, no diaspora or country targeting (the overseas arena sells foreign projects to Israelis, not Israeli projects abroad); no published lead verification or replacement guarantee; dashboard described only in press; leads stay on Yad2 pages, not on the developer's own project page; strict lock-in terms (no refund after publication, 5,000 NIS fine for package sharing); broker prices rose by tens of percent during the war (TheMarker 2024); site blocks automated readers with a bot check.

lead_handling.value: not published

audience_size_claims.value: Madlan agents page (madlan.co.il/lp/agents, as indexed by search, undated): 1,500,000 users per month, about 80,000 properties for sale and rent, over 3,500 agents and about 400 new projects. services.name: Immobilier.co.il (managed lead-generation campaigns plus listing and agency plans with portal syndication)
services.market: Israeli new-build and resale projects sold to French-speaking (60%) and English-speaking (40%) buyers in Israel and abroad; paid social in France, Belgium, Switzerland, Canada, USA, UK and Israel

sells_to_developers.value: Lead-generation campaigns: Managed lead-generation campaigns for agencies, developers and project owners, to sell units of new-build programmes to the French- and English-speaking community in Israel and abroad. Four steps: define the target with the client (city, property type, budget, buyer profile); launch multi-channel campaigns; deliver leads in real time; analyse and optimise. A dedicated conversion landing page per project. Named developer clients: Rami Levy Nadlan, Netanel Group, BST, RAYK, Lev-Sorek, NBS, Mimushim, Rendez-Vous Tel Aviv, Kardan Nadlan, Africa Israel Residences, Yossi Avrahami, Y.H. Dimri, AMIM Group. Partner agencies named: Agence du centre, Laurence Zemour, Tivour Building, Alex Losky, Lev Tel Aviv, LM Gordon, The Agencis, Immo BH360, Norder Group, EC Nadlan, Consultant Seban. | Listing and agency plans: Three agency plans. Pro: option to distribute on 113 portals, featured listings, advanced analytics. Business (labelled Most popular): Pro plus Spotlight listing boost, multi-city coverage, a dedicated Facebook page, unlimited agents. Ultimate: Business plus sponsored agency, priority positioning, market comparison, dedicated account manager, sign-up through WhatsApp. No plan is named for developers on this page; new projects are a listing category (743 new listings in the footer counter) and developer projects also appear as banners marked Advertisement on the new-projects page. Pro area offers a 30-day free trial: up to 5 listings, automatic distribution to 113 international portals from day one, built-in CRM. | Cross-check: 'Direct from developer' sponsored banners appear on the home page.

prices_and_terms.value: Lead-generation campaigns: 'From 69 ₪/lead' on the largest volumes, billed per lead (the French page says 'A partir de 69 ₪/lead'). Exact price depends on city, budget, property type and volume; custom quote, Hebrew page promises a reply within 24 hours. No minimum term, minimum order, volume tiers or setup fee published. | Listing and agency plans: Only published price: 'Starting at 5.90₪ / listing' (shekels per listing). Plan prices are not shown; French page says 'Tarifs detailles dans votre espace pro' (detailed prices in the pro area). Pro area shows '5 annonces, 0 ₪ aujourd'hui' for the 30-day trial and says fees 'seront definis dans un accord separe' (set in a separate agreement). No billing period, minimum term or setup fee published. Owner (by-owner) plans Essential, Visibility, International: no prices shown before account creation, 'Fixed price, no surprises', payment only at publishing, renewal can be stopped in one click.

channels.value: Lead-generation campaigns: Banners and landing pages on the Immobilier.co.il network of city-focused sites; email newsletters to '18,000+ qualified' French- and English-speaking contacts; Facebook and Instagram ads; Google Ads on high-intent keywords; partner news, lifestyle and community sites; '113 partner portals' stated but not named on this page. | Listing and agency plans: Own portal in 8 language versions; free newsletter with city selection (no subscriber count on the marketing page); Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn accounts. Optional worldwide distribution claimed as '113 international portals', but the same page's regional breakdown totals 67 (Europe 37, Asia 14, North America 8, Oceania 4, South America 2, Africa 2) and another line says '67+ portals'. Partner portals named on the by-owner page (MAX pack): Properstar, Realting, RealtyHive, Tranio, eSale International. Referral side services: mortgage brokers and real estate lawyers. No press or events mentioned.

targeting_options.value: Lead-generation campaigns: City, property type, budget range, buyer profile, agreed with the client. Facebook and Instagram ad countries: France, Belgium, Switzerland, Canada, USA, UK, Israel. Audience language split 60% French-speaking, 40% English-speaking. No other languages and no advertiser-side budget control published. | Listing and agency plans: Placement by Israeli city (multi-city coverage in the Business plan). Audience described as the French- and English-speaking diaspora. No advertiser-selected country, language, budget or buyer-profile targeting is described for listing plans.

lead_handling.value: Lead-generation campaigns: Each lead checked for full name, valid phone number and confirmed email; duplicates and incomplete contacts filtered out. Free replacement of an invalid lead (wrong number or off-target) after the client reports it. Delivered instantly by email, SMS or into the client's CRM. Campaign setup 5 to 7 business days; leads usually arrive over 4 to 6 weeks depending on volume. No exclusivity statement and no WhatsApp delivery mentioned. | Listing and agency plans: Leads described as 'targeted inquiries from serious buyers' with name, email, phone and property of interest. On project pages: contact-agent form, email form, callback and visit requests; agent phone number and exact address are revealed only after a form is submitted; optional checkboxes for a free borrowing-capacity check and a lawyer consultation. By-owner: messages arrive in the seller dashboard and inbox, seller phone hidden. Pro area mentions a built-in CRM 'pour suivre, relancer et convertir'. No verification or replacement guarantee is described for listing leads. | Cross-check: WhatsApp is used as the sales and support channel, not as a lead delivery channel.

reporting_dashboard.value: Lead-generation campaigns: The page says performance is analysed and campaigns optimised over time; no dashboard, report format or frequency is described. | Listing and agency plans: Analytics: views, contacts and ranking, plus comparison with other agencies in the same city. Juwai advises contact order phone, official WeChat, personal WeChat, live chat, SMS, email, mini app, and moving to WeChat after 5 calls. Juwai Live: RSVP contact list delivered within 1 week after the event; self-reported average 85 leads per event and '50 to 100+ leads per customer'. No replacement or refund guarantee, exclusivity terms or CRM integration published.

reporting_dashboard.value: Juwai Live: post-program report within 1 week and video replay on the campaign landing page. For portal and developer packages a live dashboard is not published.

self_serve_builder.value: Agency listing packages can be signed up for online (agent-signup page with package prices). Developer campaigns and Juwai Live are sold through sales (contact). No self-serve campaign builder or mobile builder published.

audience_size_claims.value: Juwai.com 'ten-million-user audience' (Juwai IQI, 30 Jul 2025). weaknesses_observed.value: Prices are 'from' figures and the visible promo price pages are from 2023; developer tier inclusions are thin (one listing, profile, placements); no live dashboard for package clients; lead volumes and outcomes are self-reported and not guaranteed; no refund or replacement policy; no CRM integration published; Douyin and Xiaohongshu not mentioned; targeting limited to China and Hong Kong in the Live product.

services.name: JamesEdition
services.market: Global luxury marketplace (real estate plus cars, yachts and other luxury goods). Sellers worldwide; buyers from about 140 countries.

sells_to_developers.value: Real estate professional sellers get an 'Elite' or 'Elite Plus' subscription with pricing tailored to the listing portfolio; land and new developments are accepted, commercial property (hotels, stores, restaurants) is not (per search index of the professional seller page, which blocks direct fetch). Paid Single Listing Promotions bought via the Business Dashboard. Featured Agent plan (US agents with up to 10 listings only). No dedicated developer or project product was found.

prices_and_terms.value: Official: custom ('Get your custom pricing'); Featured Agent and promotion prices not published in text. Third-party data points: a Dubai agent on Trustpilot reported paying EUR 2,349 for a 6-month subscription in March 2025; a review site cites older Elite subscriptions at USD 3,000 to USD 4,000 per year (unofficial); an undated Institute for Luxury Home Marketing flyer offered members USD 199 one-time per listing, shown for 3 months, minimum list price USD 650,000. Terms: subscriptions and Single Listing Promotions renew automatically; cancel at least 24 hours before the period ends; Featured Agent stays active until the end of the paid period.

channels.value: Own marketplace website and buyer app; newsletters; market intelligence reports (Global Hotspot Index) used as PR; feed partnerships with luxury brokerages and networks (e.g. Compass Luxury, Chestertons, eXp UK Luxury, Luxury Portfolio International, per search index). No paid social, Google, events or partner-portal syndication product for advertisers published.

targeting_options.value: not published (paid tiers buy search placement: Elite listings appear first in top search results; Featured Agents get premium placement). No buyer country, language, budget or retargeting options found.

lead_handling.value: Buyer inquiries go to the Business Account Inbox and by email according to routing (per listing agent, or office-only, plus a secondary leads email); reply-to is the buyer's address. 'Vendor Leads' (private owners wanting an agent) are reviewed by JamesEdition and forwarded to selected agencies. Lead Pull API returns leads as JSON with date filters and an API key, for CRM import. Listing pages offer a message form, 'Ask a Question' and phone reveal; WhatsApp not mentioned. No buyer verification, qualification, replacement or refund described.

reporting_dashboard.value: Featured Agent analytics dashboard tracks listing views, impressions and leads over time; a Master Dashboard gives an overview across multiple offices. The old ILHM flyer promised monthly statistics reporting.

self_serve_builder.value: Partly. Featured Agent upgrade is self-serve in the Subscription tab. Single Listing Promotions are requested in the dashboard, then a JamesEdition representative contacts the seller to set them up. Elite Plus requires custom pricing from sales. Buyer app exists; an advertiser mobile app is not published.

tour_3d_project_page.value: Listing pages support video and embedded virtual tours from Matterport, iGUIDE, My360 Virtual Tour, Realisti.co, Nodalview, 3DVista and VIRTEA ('opens a 3D view'), plus photo grid. No project microsite or developer project page product described.

languages.value: not published in the pages read (the site shows a translation submenu; Featured Agent profiles list the languages the agent speaks).

audience_size_claims.value: 2M+ monthly visits and 14M+ unique visitors in 2025 across 140 countries (JamesEdition Global Hotspot Index 2025 and market intelligence page, per search index). Featured Agents get 'up to 7x more impressions' than Basic accounts (vendor claim). Old undated flyer: 700,000 visits and 8 million+ page views monthly, 200+ countries.

clever_features.value: Lead Pull API for CRM; Vendor Leads (seller-side leads) as an extra benefit for agencies; Featured Agent auto-selects the best live listing for a featured Elite Plus slot; office-level lead routing with a Master Dashboard; seven supported virtual tour providers; data reports on luxury demand used for PR and SEO.

weaknesses_observed.value: No published prices; Elite Plus is custom; Featured Agent limited to US agents with up to 10 listings; promotions are not fully self-serve; automatic renewal; no lead verification or refund; no WhatsApp; no developer project product, no targeting by buyer country. Trustpilot score about 2.1 to 2.2 out of 5 with lead-volume complaints (one agent: 3 leads, none converted, for EUR 2,349 over 6 months).

services.name: Bayut (Dubizzle Group): New Projects, New Project Leads Marketplace, Profolio, Bayut Studios
services.market: UAE (plus Bayut.sa in Saudi Arabia, Bayut Bahrain, Bayut Egypt). Developers advertise to local and international investors; leads come from buyers browsing Bayut and dubizzle.

sells_to_developers.value: New Projects section where developers advertise off-plan and ready projects for exposure to international investors (about page). On 2026-11-07 it listed 3,029 projects with launch price in AED, payment plan ratio (e.g. 70/30), handover date, developer pages (Emaar, Aldar, Sobha and others) and a 'Register Interest' button. New Project Leads Marketplace (on Profolio Web): agencies connect with off-plan buyers who expressed interest in New Projects on Bayut and dubizzle and unlock those leads. DevConnect gives agents access to developers' off-plan opportunities. Bayut Studios (group 3D and PropTech arm): Prop Render, Prop Tour 360, Prop Isometric, Prop Motion, Prop Location, Prop Teasers, Prop VR, Prop Plan 3D (immersive 3D off-plan sales), PropTech Flow (digital sales platform) and PropTech Engine (real-time 3D). In Saudi Arabia (Bayut.sa) the group lists integrated developer services: project marketing, sales enablement, data-driven pricing and a marketplace where agencies sell developer inventory.

prices_and_terms.value: Developer advertising and Bayut Studios prices: not published (enquiry form). New project leads: 'each lead is dynamically priced based on the project, its location and the developer' (help centre, updated 18 Feb 2026, per search index). Agency model (Dubizzle Group IPO notice, Oct 2025): recurring annual subscriptions, spending through credits tied to expected lead generation, individuals pay per listing. Credits are refunded if a listing is rejected within 10 days; refunded credits must be used in the same credit cycle (agency wallets) or within 30 days (personal wallets). Per a Philippine marketing blog, Nov 2025 (unsourced estimate): about AED 20 to 25 per lead on Bayut.

channels.value: Bayut and dubizzle portals and apps (same group), Bayut.sa, MyBayut blog, 3,500+ agencies who resell project leads, paid placements (Signature, Hot listings, Area Prime Spot), DevConnect for agents. No international partner-portal syndication, paid social, Google or events product for developers published.

targeting_options.value: not published for developers. Lead price varies by project, location and developer. Agencies can buy Area Prime Spot (top position in a chosen area). SmartLeads captures buyer location, budget and property type, but no advertiser-side targeting by buyer country or language is described.

lead_handling.value: Unlocked new-project leads are filed under Leads Reporting > New Project in Profolio Web and App. SmartLeads collects buyer preferences and links leads to listings (all email leads and about 60% of calls). Leads arrive by email, SMS, phone, WhatsApp and chat; agents can call, email or WhatsApp from the app. Excel export and a Leads API on request. Listing trust: Checked (documents verified by QA team) and TruCheck (agent on-site photo within 500 m, valid 45 days for sales); Bayut claims TruCheck gives 5x more leads and 20x more impressions on average. TruBroker badge rewards responsiveness. Lead exclusivity, replacement or refund: not published.

reporting_dashboard.value: Profolio (web and app): Reports > Leads across 5 channels with Excel export; Reports > Traffic (impressions, listing performance); Insights per listing (impressions, clicks, leads); a 'Low Performing' filter flags listings with lower click-through than similar listings in the area. A developer-facing dashboard is not published.

self_serve_builder.value: Agencies self-serve in Profolio web and mobile app (listings, placements, unlocking project leads). Developers: no self-serve campaign builder found; Bayut Studios is enquiry-led (form plus offices in Riyadh, Dubai, Lahore).

tour_3d_project_page.value: Strong: Bayut Studios sells 3D renders, 360 tours, VR walkthroughs, Prop Plan 3D and a real-time 3D engine for off-plan projects, with some solutions said to connect to Bayut and dubizzle lead capture and CRM (per Entrepreneur Middle East). Portal has 45,000+ 2D and 3D floor plans and a '3D Live' floor-plan view. Project cards show payment plans and handover dates.

languages.value: English and Arabic for all end-user features; area guides in English and Arabic.

audience_size_claims.value: Dubizzle Group (Bayut plus dubizzle): 54 million average monthly sessions and 18 million monthly active users in H1 2025; about 65% UAE real estate classifieds traffic share (Feb 2025) and about 50% revenue share (2024); reaches 75% of the UAE property-seeking audience. Bayut.sa: 3.5 million+ monthly sessions and 2,300 paying clients (Apr 2025). Bayut: listings from 3,500+ agencies. The IPO was postponed on 22 Oct 2025.

clever_features.value: Leads marketplace selling off-plan buyer interest per lead with dynamic pricing by project, location and developer; geofenced on-site listing verification (500 m) with expiry; SmartLeads auto-matching of buyer needs to listings; WhatsApp tracked as a lead channel; low-performing listing alerts; in-house 3D studio for developers tied to lead capture; DevConnect linking developer inventory to agents; payment-plan and handover filters on project search.

weaknesses_observed.value: No published prices for developers, leads or Bayut Studios; public help pages describe project leads being sold to agencies, and no developer-side lead dashboard or follow-up control is described; lead exclusivity and refunds not published; English and Arabic only; no international portal distribution or buyer-country targeting; some help pages are a few years old (per tend.ae).

services.name: Property Finder (New Projects, PF Expert, Data Guru, SuperAgent)
services.market: UAE (largest market), Qatar, Bahrain, Egypt, Saudi Arabia; minority stake in Turkey's Zingat. Buyers are mainly regional portal users.

Data Guru (Sep 2023) gives buyers transaction data and a new-projects overview; Data Finder sells UAE transaction analytics. PropSpace, a CRM that Property Finder lists as a listing submission channel, markets a Developer Sales module (inventory, agency distribution to pre-selected agencies, microsites, email blasts, SMS, portal syndication). prices_and_terms.value: not published for developers ('contact us'). languages.value: not published in the pages read (the group runs separate sites per market: Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam).

weaknesses_observed.value: No published developer prices; FastKey developer sales platform shut (2023); Feb 2025 restructuring cut 174 jobs and closed finance and home services units; no international buyer reach; no developer lead or reporting product described publicly; much developer material is 2021 to 2022.

services.name: Zillow New Construction (Promoted Communities, Builder Boost)
services.market: United States. Domestic US buyers on Zillow, Trulia and Redfin; no overseas-buyer or diaspora product found.

sells_to_developers.value: Promoted Communities: paid community listings with plan and lot pricing, spec homes, community details, amenities and sales office hours. PC Select: a variant billed as base fee plus cost per lead. Builder Boost: on-site ads on Zillow, Trulia and Redfin with variants Boost Rent Targeting, Boost Luxury and Boost Senior Community; Builder Boost + Precision Targeting retargets Zillow shoppers on Facebook. Buyer Discovery: showcases available homes, spec homes, quick move-in homes, lots and incentives. Listing Connect (announced 2020): links MLS-listed spec homes to the Promoted Community. Builder Ratings and Reviews (per RISMedia, 19 Aug 2020: free to Promoted Communities builders). Advantage Program (2018): discounted third-party vendor tools for Promoted Communities builders. (Zillow pages refuse direct fetching; content read through search-engine excerpts of the cited pages.)

prices_and_terms.value: No public rate card. Promoted Community terms: a monthly PC Rate per active Promoted Community, pro rata for partial months. PC Select: monthly Base Fee plus Cost per Lead up to a Lead Budget per community; Zillow may post a new Cost per Lead each quarter (example in the terms: order signed 1 Feb, new rate posted by 1 Mar, effective 1 Apr); a community can be removed from PC Select only when every home in it is under contract. Per Inman (21 Mar 2018, reposted by HomesUSA): builders or their agents with 150 or more closings a year must join Promoted Communities for their listings to appear on Zillow and Trulia; price is per community per month and varies by location and community; one agent said she was pitched a USD 800 per month plan in October 2016. Zillow case study (undated): New Home Star reported a cost per contact of USD 6.58, about 30 leads per month and two sales in the first three months. (Zillow pages read through search-engine excerpts.)

channels.value: Zillow and Trulia; automatic syndication of builder listings and community pages to Redfin from Q4 2023, with Redfin sourcing non-MLS new-construction listings exclusively from Zillow (Redfin cited 50 million monthly visitors in the 1 Aug 2023 release); on-site ads on Zillow, Trulia and Redfin (Builder Boost); Facebook retargeting of Zillow shoppers (Precision Targeting); MLS display alongside agent listings through Listing Connect.

targeting_options.value: Builder Boost targets shoppers searching in the builder's area, renters (Boost Rent Targeting), shoppers filtering by price (Boost Luxury) and senior-community shoppers (Boost Senior Community); Facebook retargeting of Zillow shoppers already searching in the area. No country, language or diaspora targeting found. (Read through search-engine excerpts.)

lead_handling.value: Leads are sent directly to the builder (Listing Connect page). Email and phone leads are counted in the Builder Dashboard. Shoppers who contact a builder receive a short satisfaction survey (CSAT). CRM: a 2017 Zillow guide says many CRMs can integrate Zillow and Trulia leads; no current official CRM list found. Inman (5 Dec 2019) reported a one-click tour request feature for new construction. No lead verification, refund or replacement policy published. (Read through search-engine excerpts.)

reporting_dashboard.value: Builder Dashboard: Promoted Communities report (engagement, email and phone leads, drill-down by community and listing), Builder Boost report (past and current campaigns, by campaign and company division), spend report (total spend, effective cost per community, effective cost per contact, estimated ROI), customer satisfaction scores, listing quality and Content Completion score (completeness of community, plan and spec data). (Read through search-engine excerpts.)

self_serve_builder.value: Listings are maintained by the builder through the New Home Feed tool or a direct feed, but advertising is bought through Zillow sales and order forms (a Zillow case study lists a sales phone line). No self-serve campaign builder found. Mobile management not stated.

tour_3d_project_page.value: Community pages with photos, videos, community maps, amenity details, all available homes (move-in ready, nearly complete, lots), link to the builder website, contact details and sales center hours (Zillow and Redfin release, 1 Aug 2023). applies_where.value: Advertisers based in the US, and housing ads reaching the United States (required from 4 Dec 2019), Canada (from 3 Dec 2020) and Europe (from 7 Dec 2021). what_counts_as_housing.value: Listings for the sale or rental of a home or apartment, plus homeowners insurance, mortgage insurance, mortgage loans, housing repairs, and home equity or appraisal services (Meta help text as quoted by Jon Loomer, article updated 1 Mar 2025). New-development sales ads fall under listings for sale.

targeting_removed_or_limited.value: Age fixed to 18 to 65+. Gender cannot be chosen. Location must cover at least a 15 mile or 25 km radius in the US and Canada and 15 km in Europe. ZIP or postal code, sub-city, neighbourhood, metro area, small geo area and electoral district targeting not supported. Location exclusion not supported. Behaviour and demographic detailed targeting not permitted; detailed-targeting and interest exclusions not permitted; interests only from an approved list. Lookalike Audiences and Saved Audiences unavailable. Bid multipliers not allowed.

still_allowed.value: Custom Audience inclusion, exclusion and expansion are listed as supported (customer lists can be checked with is_eligible_for_sac_campaigns); audiences must not discriminate. Language targeting is not named among the restricted options in the doc (not explicitly confirmed as allowed).

platform_rules.cockpit_implication: Any campaign aimed at France, Belgium, the UK, other European countries, the US or Canada runs as a housing special ad: no age, gender, postcode or lookalike targeting, city targeting only with the minimum radius. Israel-only campaigns are not forced into the category.

platform_rules.rule: Removal of detailed-targeting options on sensitive topics, from 19 Jan 2022

applies_where.value: All advertisers. Meta announced on 8 Dec 2021 that from 19 Jan 2022 it removes detailed-targeting options referencing health, race or ethnicity, political affiliation, religion or sexual orientation. Examples for religion: 'Catholic Church' and 'Jewish holidays'.

targeting_removed_or_limited.value: No interest or detailed-targeting option for religious practices and groups, or for ethnicity. A 'Jewish community' audience cannot be selected as a Meta interest anywhere in the world.

still_allowed.value: Geography, language and the advertiser's own consented lists remain the levers; see the housing rule for the US, Canada and Europe.

platform_rules.cockpit_implication: Community reach must come from owned and partner channels (community media, newsletters, events, our own opted-in lists) plus country, city and language, never from a religious or ethnic platform audience.

applies_where.value: Housing restrictions: ads served in the United States and Canada; enforcement follows the ad's target location, not the advertiser's billing or physical location (Google FAQ, read through search excerpt).
